report.summary: Chunk 2 of parse.py: finishes resolve_python_imports, defines python_imports, TYPE_FACTS_VERSION, ANY_SENTINEL, and dataclasses TypeDecl, FieldDecl, ParamDecl, SignatureDecl, AliasImport, PyTypeFacts, Annotation; defines structural name sets and depth guard comment.
risks: resolve_python_imports | medium | The function's logic for matching modules and submodules uses known set and internal_tops; if known is incomplete, false negatives may occur. | Review the known set population logic in build_index.
python_imports | low | Delegates to resolve_python_imports and python_import_records; if either is buggy, this function propagates errors. | Verify unit tests for python_imports.
TYPE_FACTS_VERSION | low | Bump when meaning changes; no enforcement mechanism visible. | Ensure bump policy is documented and automated.
ANY_SENTINEL | low | Constant used to label bare Any; if consumer does not check is_any flag, it might be treated as a type name. | Verify all consumers check is_any before using members.
TypeDecl | medium | Deliberately not field-compatible with CodeUnit; if code tries to treat it as CodeUnit, AttributeError may occur. | Ensure clone pass explicitly handles TypeDecl differently.
FieldDecl | medium | Multiple origins for same name kept; deduplication logic missing in this chunk. | Plan deduplication strategy in whole-repo resolver.
ParamDecl | medium | Position is 0-based over concatenated params; off-by-one errors possible if consumer assumes different ordering. | Verify ordering logic matches Python's parameter order.
SignatureDecl | low | receiver field assumed to be self/cls; if method is staticmethod, receiver is empty string. | Ensure consumers check is_async and decorators for staticmethod.
AliasImport | low | Star imports recorded with local=='*' and orig=='*'; ambiguity detection relies on this. | Test ambiguity resolution with multiple star imports.
Annotation | medium | Dotted names kept verbatim; consumer must resolve module prefix. | Ensure resolver handles dotted names correctly.
structural name sets | low | Contains many type names; if new stdlib types appear, list may become outdated. | Periodically review and update the sets.
todos: Verify that resolve_python_imports correctly handles empty module after filtering.
Add tests for python_imports covering various import styles.
Ensure clone pass handles TypeDecl and FieldDecl without assuming CodeUnit fields.
Implement deduplication for FieldDecl with same name but different origins.
Review ordering of ParamDecl positions to match source order.
Test AliasImport star import ambiguity resolution.
Update structural name sets with new Python typing constructs.
Ensure ANY_SENTINEL is never used as an edge target.

observations.what: resolve_python_imports ends with a return statement not shown; the function may be incomplete.
python_imports function is a thin wrapper; correctness depends on python_import_records and resolve_python_imports.
TYPE_FACTS_VERSION is a string constant; no enforcement that it bumps on schema changes.
ANY_SENTINEL is '<any>' which is not a valid Python identifier; safe from name collision.
TypeDecl, FieldDecl, ParamDecl, SignatureDecl, AliasImport, PyTypeFacts, Annotation are all frozen dataclasses; immutable and hashable.
FieldDecl has origin field with documented meanings but no validation that origin values are restricted to the four documented values.
ParamDecl position is 0-based over concatenated params; potential off-by-one errors if consumer assumes different ordering.
SignatureDecl receiver field is empty string for non-methods; consumer must check decorators for staticmethod.
AliasImport records star imports with local='*' and orig='*'; ambiguity detection relies on this.
PyTypeFacts fields are all tuples; safe for default dataclass without default_factory.
Annotation dataclass has many fields; construction logic is not in this chunk.
Structural name sets are defined; _STRUCTURAL_NAMES is union of all. Missing sets for other structural names like Literal.
Comment mentions depth guards for annotations and statements; no constants defined in this chunk.
